about: Approved minimal cross-platform scene contract for SSL-615. Human-authored scene and mission instances use TOML; rectangles use x/y/w/h in a 0..1 safe-area coordinate space.

journey.source: Craft: Landnam: community research calendar + simpler progression (22 Oct 2026, including Liam's comments)

stages.name: Plan
stages.policy: One Plan for contracts and Free Ops. Suggest a ship; changing it is optional.

stages.name: Launch
stages.policy: Assembly and launch are one scene. Preserve old routes as deep links.

stages.name: Flight
stages.policy: A faster multi-scene animated sequence with zero required confirmation taps.

stages.name: Work
stages.policy: Perform mining, survey or field work with the appropriate engine adapter.

stages.name: Result
stages.policy: Combine delivery and result presentation, preserving exactly-once cargo and reward settlement, then return to Base.

base.description: Pan/zoom home world with buildings and fixed sites.

travel.description: Launch, transit, landing, delivery, return and debrief views.

field.description: Direct-control mining, rover and surface operations.

build.description: Assembly and customisation around a physical vehicle or structure.

exchange-lab.description: In-world instruments, trading and processing surfaces.

menu.description: Reference, selection and record surfaces; cards are allowed here.

objectContract.rule: Scene files own structure and placement; platform code owns behavior and rendering adapters.
